title: 出口单证重量差异与边境押运放行决策
english: Export document discrepancies and border release decisions

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 8分钟：逐条慢速3遍，正常速度3遍，练习重音。
lines: Certificate of origin
原产地证书
Export declaration
出口申报单
Consignment reference
托运批次编号
Document discrepancy
单证差异
Release instruction
放行指令
Traceability record
溯源记录

modules.title: 10高频词/短语
lines: Commercial invoice
商业发票
Packing list
装箱单

modules.title: 10核心句
modules.hint: 8分钟：按问题、证据、行动顺序练习。
lines: The invoice quantity does not match the packing list.
发票数量与装箱单不一致。
Please hold the truck at the secure loading bay.
请让车辆停在安全装货区。
We need the signed export permit before dispatch.
发运前需要已签署的出口许可证。
The declared value must be supported by the contract.
申报价值必须有合同依据。
Please verify the consignee's legal name.
请核实收货人的法定名称。
The seal number must match the stuffing report.
封签号必须与装柜报告一致。
Do not amend the invoice without an audit trail.
没有审计轨迹不得修改发票。
Our compliance review is still in progress.
我们的合规审核仍在进行。
We can issue release instructions after reconciliation.
完成核对后我们才能发出放行指令。
Please send the corrected documents before the cut-off.
请在截止时间前发送更正文件。

modules.title: 金额吨位品位汇率口述
modules.hint: 6分钟：所有数据为虚构练习；先读数字再说业务含义。
lines: The shipment weighs fourteen point eight metric tonnes gross.
该批货毛重14.8公吨。
The measured moisture content is three point two percent.
测得含水率为3.2%。
The illustrative dry weight is fourteen point three two six four tonnes.
模拟净干重为14.3264吨。
The indicative tin grade is fifty-eight point six percent.
模拟锡品位为58.6%。
The invoice value is forty-two thousand six hundred US dollars.
模拟发票金额为42600美元。
The training exchange rate is one dollar to one thousand five hundred francs.
训练汇率为1美元兑1500法郎。
The corresponding illustrative amount is sixty-three million nine hundred thousand francs.
对应模拟金额为6390万法郎。
We must distinguish gross tonnes from dry tonnes.
我们必须区分毛吨与干吨。

modules.title: Shadowing
modules.hint: 5分钟：先听一次，再跟读5次，最后连贯复述。
lines: Our export documents contain a mismatch between the commercial invoice and the packing list.
我们的出口单证中商业发票与装箱单不一致。
The truck is secured while the logistics and compliance teams reconcile the records.
物流和合规团队核对记录期间，车辆保持安全停放。
We will not instruct the driver to depart until the corrected documents are approved.
更正文件获批前，我们不会指示司机发车。
Please preserve the original documents and record every revision.
请保存原始文件并记录每次修改。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 3分钟：礼貌开场、确认进度、转入问题。
lines: Good morning. Did the customs broker receive our documents?
早上好，报关代理收到我们的文件了吗？
Yes, but the broker flagged a weight discrepancy.
收到了，但代理指出重量差异。
Thank you for spotting it before dispatch.
感谢在发运前发现问题。
Could we review the records together now?
我们现在可以一起核对记录吗？
Certainly. I will share the signed originals first.
当然，我会先分享签字原件。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 6分钟：压力点一：客户催促先出货；压力点二：发票金额与合同不同。给出示范拒绝。
lines: The buyer insists on immediate dispatch despite the invoice discrepancy.
尽管发票存在差异，买方仍坚持立即发货。
I understand the deadline, but dispatch without reconciled documents would create a compliance risk.
我理解截止时间，但单证未核对就发运会产生合规风险。
The supplier proposes changing the invoice value without a signed amendment.
供应商建议不签补充协议就更改发票金额。
We cannot change the declared value without contractual evidence and written approval.
没有合同依据和书面批准，我们不能修改申报价值。
Please compare the purchase order, assay certificate, invoice, and payment instruction.
请核对采购订单、化验报告、发票和付款指令。
If the grade basis differs, explain whether the settlement uses wet or dry weight.
如果品位计算基础不同，请说明结算采用湿重还是干重。

modules.title: 运输押运/海关
modules.hint: 5分钟：压力点三：押运车已到关口，单证未完成。
lines: The escort officer reports that the truck has reached the border staging area.
押运员报告车辆已抵达边境待检区。
Do not break the seal or transfer the cargo while the records are under review.
记录审核期间不得拆封或转运货物。
Record the vehicle plate, seal number, arrival time, and handover signatures.
记录车牌、封签号、到达时间及交接签字。
Ask the customs broker to confirm which document must be corrected.
请报关代理确认需要更正哪份文件。
Send the updated stuffing report only after the physical details have been verified.
只有核实实物信息后才能发送更新的装柜报告。
Escalate any unexplained change to the traceability officer.
任何无法解释的变化均须升级报告给溯源负责人。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 15分钟：三轮各5分钟，每轮至少讲5句；示范答复如下。
lines: Round one: The buyer demands dispatch within ten minutes despite a packing-list mismatch.
第一轮：买方要求十分钟内发货，但装箱单不一致。
Model answer: We can prioritize the review, but we cannot release the cargo until the quantity is reconciled and signed off.
示范：我们可以优先审核，但数量核对并签字前不能放货。
Round two: The supplier asks you to increase the invoice value without a contract amendment.
第二轮：供应商要求在无合同补充协议情况下提高发票金额。
Model answer: Please provide the signed pricing amendment and assay basis. We will not submit an unsupported value.
示范：请提供签署的价格补充协议和化验依据；我们不会申报缺乏依据的金额。
Round three: The escort officer says the border gate will close soon.
第三轮：押运员称边境关口即将关闭。
Model answer: Park securely, preserve the seal, and send the handover log. We will issue instructions after compliance clearance.
示范：安全停车、保护封签、发送交接日志；合规放行后我们再下达指令。
Follow-up challenge: The buyer threatens a penalty for delay.
追加压力：买方威胁就延误收取违约金。
Model answer: We will document the cause and review contractual remedies, but we will not bypass export controls.
示范：我们会记录原因并核查合同救济条款，但不会绕过出口管控。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 4分钟：先隐藏英文听写，再核对。
lines: The invoice and packing list must agree.
发票与装箱单必须一致。
Please verify the declared net weight.
请核实申报净重。
The truck must remain at the secure checkpoint.
车辆必须留在安全检查点。
We need written approval before dispatch.
发运前需要书面批准。
Keep a complete record of every correction.
完整记录每一次更正。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 3分钟：每题回答30秒，按结论、理由、行动三部分组织。
lines: What would you do if the packing list and invoice showed different weights?
装箱单与发票重量不同时怎么办？
How would you explain a compliance hold to an impatient buyer?
如何向急躁买方解释合规暂缓？
Which documents would you compare before approving an invoice amendment?
批准发票修改前核对哪些文件？
How would you instruct an escort officer waiting at the border?
如何指示边境等候的押运员？
What evidence would justify releasing a shipment?
哪些证据能够支持放行货物？

modules.title: 前三课复习
modules.hint: 2分钟：复习已知近三课主题，不虚构缺课。
lines: Day twenty-seven covered assay disputes and settlement controls.
第27课讨论化验争议与结算控制。
Day twenty-eight covered beneficiary changes and sanctions screening.
第28课讨论收款人变更与制裁筛查。
Day twenty-nine covered pricing windows and price exposure.
第29课讨论点价窗口与价格敞口。
Today's lesson connects document reconciliation with physical cargo release.
今天把单证核对与实物放行连接起来。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 5分钟：先逐句跟读，最后不看文本连贯陈述。
lines: Good morning. We have identified a discrepancy between the commercial invoice and the packing list for today's mineral shipment.
早上好，我们发现今天矿产品货运的商业发票与装箱单不一致。
The gross weight, dry weight, and declared value must be reconciled against the signed contract and laboratory records.
毛重、干重和申报价值必须与签署的合同及化验记录核对。
The buyer has requested immediate dispatch, but we cannot authorize release while these differences remain unresolved.
买方要求立即发货，但差异未解决前我们不能授权放行。
Our logistics team has secured the truck and instructed the escort officer to preserve the existing seal.
物流团队已妥善停放车辆，并指示押运员保护现有封签。
The customs broker is identifying the documents that require correction, and compliance is reviewing the supporting evidence.
报关代理正在确认需要更正的文件，合规团队正在审核支持证据。
We will retain the original documents, record each revision, and obtain written approval before submitting replacements.
我们将保留原始文件、记录每次修改，并在提交替换文件前取得书面批准。
We recognize the commercial deadline, but we will not compromise traceability or customs compliance.
我们理解商业截止时间，但不会牺牲溯源或海关合规。
Once the figures and seal details match, we will issue a documented release instruction and notify all parties.
数字和封签信息一致后，我们将发出有记录的放行指令并通知各方。

我回答了五道口语题并完成五句听写。
